description: Borne Incendie - Angers Loire Métropole is a dataset listed in Angers Loire Métropole - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Angers Loire Métropole. Localisation des bornes et poteaux incendie à Angers Loire Métropole. ADRESSE: Adresse CODEINSEE: Code INSEE COMMUNE: Commune DEBIT: Débit du poteau DIAMETRE: Diamètre EQUIPDISPO: Equipement disponible IDVOIE: Identifiant de la voie NOMVOIE: Nom de la voie NUMPOMPIER: Identifiant SDIS PRESSION: Pression statique mesurée TYPE: Type. Coverage: Angers Loire Métropole. The portal files it under Réseaux, Energies. Its keywords are lutte anti-incendie, hydrant, incendie, pompiers. The portal shows 3,554 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-angers-fr-portal.
